repo_notes.content: OmniRoute is a local-first AI API routing gateway that unifies 237+ AI providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint on port 20128. It is a Next.js 16 (App Router) monorepo written in TypeScript (src/) and JavaScript (open-sse/, electron/), using better-sqlite3 for persistence (DATA_DIR defaults to ~/.omniroute/), Tailwind v4 for styling, next-intl for i18n (42 locales), Zod v4 for validation, and Electron for the desktop app. The repo has THREE top-level source roots that must all be documented: (1) src/ — Next.js app, API routes, DB layer, domain logic, UI dashboard; (2) open-sse/ — the core streaming/routing engine, handlers, executors, translators, services, MCP server; (3) electron/ — desktop wrapper. Do NOT treat open-sse/ as a leaf dependency — it is the heart of the system and contains ~115 service modules, the combo routing engine, all provider executors, format translators, and the MCP server (94 tools).
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: PRIORITIZE the open-sse/ workspace in documentation. The request pipeline flows: src/app/api/v1/*/route.ts -> open-sse/handlers/chatCore.ts::handleChatCore() -> (optional) open-sse/services/combo.ts::handleComboChat() -> open-sse/translator/ -> open-sse/executors/ -> upstream provider fetch -> response translation -> SSE/JSON to client. The combo engine in open-sse/services/combo.ts implements 17 routing strategies (priority, weighted, round-robin, least-used, cost-optimized, p2c, context-relay, auto, lkgp, etc.) and resolveComboTargets() expands a combo into an ordered ResolvedComboTarget[]. Each target calls handleSingleModel() which wraps handleChatCore() with per-target circuit breaker checks.
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: The data layer lives in src/lib/db/ with 83+ domain-specific SQLite modules (NOT a single file). core.ts provides getDbInstance() singleton with WAL journaling and 17 base tables. migrationRunner.ts applies versioned SQL files from db/migrations/ (106+ migrations) inside transactions, tracked in _omniroute_migrations. Each domain module owns specific tables: providers.ts -> provider_connections, combos.ts -> combos, models.ts -> models, apiKeys.ts -> api_keys, etc. src/lib/localDb.ts is a RE-EXPORT layer only — never add logic there. Encryption helpers protect sensitive fields (API keys, OAuth tokens) at rest.
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: Provider categories: Free (3: Qoder AI, Qwen Code, Kiro AI), OAuth (14: Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Kimi Coding, Kilo Code, Cline, Qwen, Kiro, Qoder, Gemini, Windsurf, GitLab Duo), API Key (120+: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, xAI, Mistral, etc.), Self-Hosted (8+: LM Studio, vLLM, etc.), and Custom (openai-compatible-* / anthropic-compatible-* prefixes). Providers are registered in src/shared/constants/providers.ts with Zod validation at module load. Provider-specific executors live in open-sse/executors/ (base.ts, default.ts, cursor.ts, codex.ts, antigravity.ts, github.ts, kiro.ts, qoder.ts, vertex.ts, cloudflare-ai.ts, opencode.ts, pollinations.ts, puter.ts). The Windsurf provider (added v3.8) has its own executor with tool-call-loop detection for swe-1.7 and per-tool schema caps.
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: Resilience is 3-layered: (1) Provider Circuit Breakers in open-sse/services/accountFallback.ts — 500/502/503/504 failures count toward a threshold that trips a breaker for providerCooldownMs; (2) Account Fallback — error classification differentiates CONTEXT_OVERFLOW (triggers model fallback) vs MODEL_ACCESS_DENIED (triggers account fallback); (3) Chat-level retries with exponential backoff in BaseExecutor. T5 intra-family fallback recomputes headers using only the fallback model id. modelFamilyFallback.ts and emergencyFallback.ts handle deeper fallback chains.
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: The MCP server at open-sse/mcp-server/ exposes 94 tools (TOTAL_MCP_TOOL_COUNT in server.ts) across 3 transports (stdio via 'omniroute --mcp', SSE at /api/mcp/sse, Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp/stream). Tool sets: core (20), cache (2), compression (5), 1proxy (3), memory (3), skill (4), agentSkill (3), pool (6), gamification (8), plugin (8), notion (6), obsidian (22). 30 scopes control per-API-key access. Every invocation is audit-logged to the mcp_audit table. The A2A v0.3 server at src/lib/a2a/ implements JSON-RPC 2.0 with SSE streaming, a Task Manager (submitted->working->completed/failed/canceled with TTL cleanup), Agent Card at /.well-known/agent.json, and 6 skills (smartRouting, quotaManagement, providerDiscovery, costAnalysis, healthReport, listCapabilities).
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: Prompt compression is a first-class subsystem in open-sse/services/compression/. Modes: off/lite/standard/aggressive/ultra/rtk/stacked. lite.ts has 5 techniques (collapseWhitespace, dedupSystemPrompt, compressToolResults, removeRedundantContent, replaceImageUrls) for 10-15% savings at <1ms. caveman.ts/cavemanRules.ts does semantic condensation with file-loaded language packs under compression/rules/. engines/rtk/ is rule-based terminal/tool-output compression with a JSON DSL (replace, match-output short-circuit, strip/keep, truncation, inline tests, trust-gated custom filters). strategySelector.ts picks the mode based on config > combo assignment > override > auto-trigger > default. DB settings in src/lib/db/compression.ts, combos in compressionCombos.ts.
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: SECURITY-CRITICAL patterns that must be documented accurately: (1) Public upstream OAuth identifiers (Gemini/Antigravity/Windsurf client_id/secret + Firebase Web keys) MUST use resolvePublicCred() from open-sse/utils/publicCreds.ts, never string literals — see docs/security/PUBLIC_CREDS.md. (2) Error responses (HTTP/SSE/executor/MCP) MUST use buildErrorBody() or sanitizeErrorMessage() from open-sse/utils/error.ts, never raw err.stack/err.message — see docs/security/ERROR_SANITIZATION.md. (3) exec()/spawn() with runtime values MUST pass via env option, never string-interpolate — see src/mitm/cert/install.ts::updateNssDatabases. (4) Guardrails in src/lib/guardrails/ are hot-reloadable, fail-open, 3 built-in (pii-masker, prompt-injection, vision-bridge). pii-masker is OFF by default (PII_REDACTION_ENABLED/PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION both default false) — NEVER make PII default-on. (5) Authorization pipeline at src/server/authz/ classifies routes into PUBLIC/CLIENT_API/MANAGEMENT. (6) Prompt injection guard at src/middleware/promptInjectionGuard.ts is unique to chat completions (clones request).
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

repo_notes.content: Doc accuracy is enforced in CI. The script scripts/check/check-fabricated-docs.mjs extracts every route path, env var, hook name, function name, and file reference from docs/**/*.md and verifies each against the codebase. Run via 'npm run check:docs-all'. Rule: if 'grep -rn theName src/ open-sse/ bin/' returns nothing, the name does not exist — do not document it. Every claim should cite real source (file.ts:line) not paraphrase. Live counts refresh with 'npm run check:docs-all' — never state provider/tool/migration counts from memory.
repo_notes.author: OmniRoute maintainer

pages.title: OmniRoute Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction: what OmniRoute is (unified AI routing gateway, 237+ providers, port 20128), the core value proposition (quota exhaustion + provider lock-in solutions, 4-tier fallback Subscription->API Key->Cheap->Free), 3 deployment modes (npm CLI, Electron desktop, Docker), and the monorepo layout (src/, open-sse/, electron/). Reference README.md, llm.txt, package.json.

pages.title: System Architecture
pages.purpose: End-to-end architecture diagram and component map. Document the request pipeline from client -> Next.js route -> open-sse/handlers/chatCore.ts -> combo routing -> translator -> executor -> upstream -> response translation -> SSE. Show how src/, open-sse/, and electron/ relate. Reference docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/architecture/REPOSITORY_MAP.md.

pages.title: Request Pipeline
pages.purpose: Deep dive into open-sse/handlers/chatCore.ts::handleChatCore() — the central entry point. Document cache check (semantic + signature), rate limit check (rateLimitManager), combo routing dispatch, translateRequest() call, executor selection, response translation, and Responses API transform stream. List all handlers in open-sse/handlers/ (chatCore, responsesHandler, embeddings, imageGeneration, videoGeneration, musicGeneration, audioSpeech, audioTranscription, moderations, rerank, search).

pages.title: Combo Routing Engine
pages.purpose: Document open-sse/services/combo.ts: handleComboChat() entry point, resolveComboTargets() expansion into ordered ResolvedComboTarget[], handleSingleModel() wrapper with per-target circuit breaker checks. Enumerate all 17 routing strategies from ROUTING_STRATEGY_VALUES in src/shared/constants/routingStrategies.ts (priority, weighted, fill-first, round-robin, P2C, random, least-used, reset-aware, reset-window, cost-optimized, strict-random, auto, lkgp, context-optimized, context-relay, comboStickyRoundRobinLimit, etc.). Reference docs/routing/AUTO-COMBO.md for the 12-factor auto-combo scoring.

pages.title: Provider Registry and Executors
pages.purpose: Document src/shared/constants/providers.ts (Zod-validated provider registry), open-sse/config/providerRegistry.ts (model catalog), and open-sse/executors/ (base.ts BaseExecutor with buildUrl/buildHeaders/transformRequest/retry, default.ts DefaultExecutor for OpenAI-compatible, plus provider-specific: cursor, codex, antigravity, github, kiro, qoder, vertex, cloudflare-ai, opencode, pollinations, puter). pages.title: Windsurf Provider Integration
pages.purpose: Document the Windsurf provider (added v3.8): OAuth authentication flow, the swe-1.7 model family, tool-call-loop detection and breaking logic, per-tool schema caps, tool sanitization, CCR first-system-prompt keep behavior, 502 invalid_argument skip-retry for model family fallback, and hyphen-notation model ID fallback handling. Reference recent commits in git log (fix(windsurf) series). This page is critical because Windsurf is the most actively-developed provider integration.

pages.title: Format Translation
pages.purpose: Document open-sse/translator/ — bidirectional hub-and-spoke conversion between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Responses API formats. translateRequest(body, sourceFormat, targetFormat) detects source and applies the matching translator module. Response translation runs in reverse. Document open-sse/transformer/responsesTransformer.ts::createResponsesApiTransformStream() which converts Chat Completions SSE chunks into Responses API SSE events. Include Grok /v1/responses native support.

pages.title: Resilience and Fallback
pages.purpose: Document the 3-layer resilience: (1) Provider Circuit Breakers in open-sse/services/accountFallback.ts (500/502/503/504 -> threshold -> providerCooldownMs); (2) Account Fallback error classification (CONTEXT_OVERFLOW -> model fallback, MODEL_ACCESS_DENIED -> account fallback); (3) Chat-level retries with exponential backoff in BaseExecutor. Cover T5 intra-family fallback (recomputes headers using only fallback model id), modelFamilyFallback.ts, emergencyFallback.ts, and quota preflight via getProviderCredentialsWithQuotaPreflight. Reference docs/architecture/RESILIENCE_GUIDE.md.

pages.title: Data Layer and SQLite Schema
pages.purpose: Document src/lib/db/ — 83+ domain modules over better-sqlite3 with WAL. core.ts getDbInstance() singleton, SCHEMA_SQL with 17 base tables, rowToCamel/encryptConnectionFields helpers. migrationRunner.ts applies 106+ versioned SQL files from db/migrations/ in transactions, tracked in _omniroute_migrations. List key domain modules and their tables: providers.ts->provider_connections, combos.ts->combos, models.ts->models, apiKeys.ts->api_keys, secrets.ts, usage*.ts, quotaSnapshots.ts, creditBalance.ts, compressionAnalytics.ts, evals.ts, webhooks.ts, reasoningCache.ts, etc. Note that localDb.ts is re-export only.

JSON-RPC methods: message/send (sync), message/stream (SSE), tasks/get, tasks/cancel dispatched via POST /a2a. Reference docs/frameworks/A2A-SERVER.md and docs/frameworks/AGENT_PROTOCOLS_GUIDE.md.

pages.title: Prompt Compression Pipeline
pages.purpose: Document open-sse/services/compression/ — modes (off/lite/standard/aggressive/ultra/rtk/stacked). lite.ts 5 techniques for 10-15% savings at <1ms. caveman.ts/cavemanRules.ts semantic condensation with language packs under compression/rules/. engines/rtk/ rule-based terminal/tool-output compression with JSON DSL (replace, match-output short-circuit, strip/keep, truncation, inline tests, trust-gated custom filters). engines/registry.ts registers engines and powers stacked pipelines. strategySelector.ts priority: assigned combo > override > auto-trigger > default. stats.ts per-request tracking. pages.title: Guardrails and Security

Request opt-out via x-omniroute-disabled-guardrails header. Document security patterns: resolvePublicCred() for public OAuth creds (docs/security/PUBLIC_CREDS.md), buildErrorBody()/sanitizeErrorMessage() for error responses (docs/security/ERROR_SANITIZATION.md), exec()/spawn() env-option rule, authorization pipeline (src/server/authz/ classify->policies->enforce, 3 route classes PUBLIC/CLIENT_API/MANAGEMENT), prompt injection guard (src/middleware/promptInjectionGuard.ts, chat completions only). pages.title: Fork and Upstream Workflow
pages.purpose: Document that this repo is a fork of diegosouzapw/OmniRoute. Fork-only operational changes (GHCR image publishing, personal deployment, local automation) must stay out of upstream PRs. PR branches must start from upstream/main (git fetch upstream; git switch -c <branch> upstream/main). Cherry-pick only intended changes. NEVER close a contributor's PR after using their code — always merge via GitHub so they get credit (see .agents/workflows/review-prs.md).
